document.name: WorkspaceSettingsScreen
document.purpose: Lets a workspace owner adjust general, notification and access settings, which apply immediately, and carry out the destructive ownership actions.

props.title: Workspace settings
props.description: Changes apply to everyone in the workspace as soon as you make them.

props.label: Workspace name
props.description: Changes the name members see in the sidebar and in emails.

props.label: Time zone
props.description: Changes the time zone in which dates and times are shown to everyone.

props.label: Email digest
props.description: Turns on a summary email of workspace activity for every member.

props.label: Digest frequency
props.description: Changes how often the digest email is sent: daily or weekly.

props.label: Members can invite people
props.description: Lets any member, not just owners, invite new people to the workspace.

props.label: Transfer ownership
props.description: Makes another member the owner of the workspace; you lose owner rights.

props.label: Delete workspace
props.description: Permanently deletes the workspace and every project in it. This cannot be undone.

props.confirmWithLabel: Type the workspace name to confirm
